newsitem.title: GERMANY: Phoenix 1996 sales steady at 1.45 bln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix 1996 sales steady at 1.45 bln dmk.

text.p: German auto parts maker Phoenix AG said on Wednesday that 1996 group sales were hardly changed from the year before at 1.45 billion marks and that profits during the year improved slightly.
The company added that it expected higher sales and a clearly better profit in 1997. The company reported group 1995 sales of 1.448 billion marks.
Phoenix 1996 sales steady at 1.45 bln dmk
The company attributed the sales figures, which followed on a record year in 1995, to growth in its core businesses, especially in noise dampening parts.
Phoenix supplies many of Germany's leading carmakers with rubber and plastic parts including component mounts and speciality hoses.
